extraction_notes: The datasheet is a shared BAS21 through BAS21S family sheet; BAS21S is explicitly identified by the BAS21S marking and its family ratings and characteristics are used for this target.
All numeric values are converted to SI units. Typical curve points are direct manual digitizations from the plotted Ta = 25 degC curves and are not interpolated.

The electrical-characteristics table provides maximum forward voltage at IF = 100 mA and 200 mA, maximum reverse leakage at VR = 200 V, maximum total capacitance at VR = 0 V and 1 MHz, and maximum reverse recovery time under the stated test circuit.
The reverse breakdown voltage and its defining current are paired from the p. 1 maximum-ratings entry at IR = 100 uA.
